scope.mutability: Seed data and permanent test-environment changes are allowed.
scope.viewportPolicy: Use 1792x976 by default; add 1440x900, 1024x768, 390x844 or another relevant size only for responsive/layout findings.
scope.passwordPolicy: Any existing-user password changed during testing must be restored immediately and the restored credential must be verified before continuing.
scope.completionRule: Every finding must end PASS or FAIL. BLOCKED is permitted only for a demonstrated product/environment failure after one bounded remediation attempt; PASSED_OVER is not permitted in this rerun.

executionWaves.objective: Create the seed manifest, mailbox aliases, correlation prefix, starting-balance snapshot and cleanup/restoration ledger.
Repair/create stable identities and prove every required role can authenticate and reach its protected surface.
Close profile, accessibility, Admin, KYC and Support findings using the newly authorized actors.
Close date, request-creation and Investor preference findings with reusable low-risk fixtures.
Close assessment-editor, RFI, rework, messaging and communications findings.
Close financial and session lifecycles with pre-recorded balances, credits and mailbox assertions.
Close grants, projects, marketplace and Pitcher lifecycle findings using seeded multi-actor records.
Close organization/public and account-closure lifecycles, then reconcile reports and remove PASSED_OVER from this scope.
